_comment: Register table (DRAFT, 2026-11-22; contents and addresses are decided in the 2/20 board-interface session). One source for the SystemVerilog register block, the C header and the markdown map (sw/regs/regtool.py; after Chipyard's register maps and OpenTitan's reggen, docs/design-notes.md). JSON is a subset of hjson, the format reggen uses.
name: soc_regs

registers.name: TOHOST
registers.desc: End of program / test result (decoded in fpga/rtl/soc.v).

registers.name: SEG
registers.desc: Hex digits on the 7-segment display (decoded in fpga/rtl/soc.v).

fields.name: value
fields.desc: Basys3 shows bits [15:0], Nexys A7 all 32

registers.name: CTRL
registers.desc: Start the measured region and clear the counters.

fields.name: clear
fields.desc: write 1: clear the cycle and event counters

registers.name: CYCLE_LO
registers.desc: Gated cycle counter, low word (after ZynqParrot).

registers.name: EV_DOT4
registers.desc: Event counter: retired dot4 instructions (after FireSim AutoCounter).

registers.name: EV_BUS_WAIT
registers.desc: Event counter: cycles waiting on the bus handshake.

registers.name: RETIRE_SIG
registers.desc: Board retire signature: CRC of retired write-back values (after FireSim TracerV).

registers.name: SCRATCH
registers.desc: Read / write register for bring-up checks.
